title: NVIDIA fiscal 2027 second-quarter CFO commentary
excerpt: Supply commitments rose to $279 billion and August land, power and shell guarantees were capped at $105 billion for about 4.25 GW.
summary: The commentary confirms exceptionally strong demand but also a material shift toward financing and guaranteeing ecosystem buildout, alongside 60-day receivables, $31.6 billion inventory, $25.0 billion of new debt and lower sequential operating cash flow.
